output.Headline: Audit Before You Ship
output.Subtitle: Waiting for harm is not a policy
output.Body:
Labs ship big new models each year. The tests come too late. By then the harm is done. The public pays the cost.

We can fix this. Each lab should test its model first. A third party should check the work. The law can set the bar.
